abstract_sentences.text: Biosignals offer valuable insights into the physiological states of the human body.

evidence.anchor: valuable insights into the physiological states

abstract_sentences.text: Although biosignal modalities differ in functionality, signal fidelity, sensor comfort, and cost, they are often intercorrelated, reflecting the holistic and interconnected nature of human physiology.

evidence.anchor: modalities differ in functionality, signal fidelity

abstract_sentences.text: This opens up the possibility of performing the same tasks using alternative biosignal modalities, thereby improving the accessibility, usability, and adaptability of health monitoring systems.

evidence.anchor: performing the same tasks using alternative biosignal modalities

abstract_sentences.text: However, the limited availability of large labeled datasets presents challenges for training models tailored to specific tasks and modalities of interest.

evidence.anchor: limited availability of large labeled datasets

abstract_sentences.text: Unsupervised cross-modal knowledge transfer offers a promising solution by leveraging knowledge from an existing modality to support model training for a new modality.

evidence.anchor: leveraging knowledge from an existing modality

abstract_sentences.text: Existing methods are typically based on knowledge distillation, which requires running a teacher model alongside student model training, resulting in high computational and memory overhead.

evidence.anchor: running a teacher model alongside student model training

abstract_sentences.text: This challenge is further exacerbated by the recent development of foundation models that demonstrate superior performance and generalization across tasks at the cost of large model sizes.

evidence.anchor: exacerbated by the recent development of foundation models

abstract_sentences.text: To this end, we explore a new framework for unsupervised cross-modal knowledge transfer of biosignals by training a lightweight bridge network to align the intermediate representations and enable information flow between foundation models and across modalities.

evidence.anchor: training a lightweight bridge network to align

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, we introduce an efficient strategy for selecting alignment positions where the bridge should be constructed, along with a flexible prototype network as the bridge architecture.

evidence.anchor: efficient strategy for selecting alignment positions

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments across multiple biosignal modalities, tasks, and datasets show that BioX-Bridge reduces the number of trainable parameters by 88–99% while maintaining or even improving transfer performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

evidence.anchor: reduces the number of trainable parameters by 88–99%

abstract_sentences.text: Our code is available at: https://github.com/chenqi-li/BioX-Bridge.

evidence.anchor: many biosignal sensors are not suitable for use outside clinical settings

final_judgment.single_storyline: 在 paired、unlabelled biosignal data 下冻结两侧模型，以 pseudo-label probing 选择有任务信息的 new 层，以 CKA 选择可连接的 old 层，再用 prototype + low-rank bridge 对齐最终表示并复用 old task head；参数效率是主卖点，位置选择是识别机制。证据：p.5–7 §3.3–3.5、p.8 Table 1。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Figure 2/3、Eq. (1)–(7)、Algorithm 1 交代信息路径和训练边界；Table 1、Figure 4、Table 2–3 交代六方向、低数据、位置策略和 foundation-model 替换。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: preprocessing、split ratios、learning rates、loss、grid、标准差、层曲线、九位置 heatmap、传统 backbone、模型规模、FC-Bridge、reshuffled subjects 和完整 limitations 移入 Appendix A–D；因此离散程度、FOG 低数据失败、subject 异质性需读附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 把“任务信息质量”和“表示相似度”分成两个可诊断的选层指标；Table 1 统一呈现效能/参数；Table A8 用 FC-Bridge 提供结构反事实。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “comparable or superior”在六方向三指标上并非逐项成立；exact alignment 推论没有近似误差或收敛分析；“any model/modality”和“modality-agnostic”超过有限 backbone/数据覆盖；Appendix D.1.1 的 ISRUC PPG 句增加复现歧义。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 声称轻量 bridge 同时带来性能和效率时，应把“选层诊断量—桥结构—主结果—结构替代消融”放在同一因果链，并在附录公开完整离散量和失败切片。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有 paired/unlabelled 数据、两侧 backbone 可冻结且存在中间表示的两模态迁移；无 paired data、无每模态预训练模型、task-agnostic、多于两模态或跨数据集泛化时，本文证据只能标为 open/future work。
